world.description: A rain-soaked temple hill at dusk: a story in four chapters and a silent bell.

lines: Each gate was a gift from someone who once climbed this hill.
Walk slowly. The rain keeps their names.
params.name: Monk Ryōkan
params.persona: an old monk who tells the temple’s story in short, quiet sentences

lines: A girl once lit every lantern on this slope in one night.
Light this one, and the path will remember you.
params.name: Monk Ryōkan
params.persona: an old monk who tells the temple’s story in short, quiet sentences

lines: Five roofs, five elements. Earth, water, fire, wind, sky.
The storm has never once put out its lamp.
params.name: Monk Ryōkan
params.persona: an old monk who tells the temple’s story in short, quiet sentences

lines: The great bell has been silent since the keeper left.
Light the four shrine lanterns, then ring it with E.

pagoda.description: A detailed twelve-meter East Asian pagoda with three to seven tapering stories, four-sided upturned eaves, balconies, timber framing, a stone base, and a gold finial spire.

torii-gate.description: Detailed Japanese torii gate with tapered vermilion pillars, black stone bases, layered collars, two crossbeams, an upswept top lintel, and a central gold-accented plaque.

intro.objective: Climb the torii path, hear all four chapters, then ring the great bell with E.
intro.tagline: Rain on a thousand gates, lanterns waking one by one, an old monk’s story.
intro.title: Kyoto Temple Lanterns

world.name: Kyoto Temple Lanterns

rules.description: Chapter III — The Pagoda in the Rain

then.text: Chapter III — The Pagoda in the Rain
Prologue — Climb through the gates. Stop at every shrine.

rules.description: Press E at the bell once every chapter is told

then.text: The bell waits. Hear every chapter first.
Epilogue — The bell rolls down the hill through the rain, and every lantern answers.
